formula: (1 + assumed change in valuation-relevant earnings power)*(1 + assumed valuation-multiple change)-1 + assumed remaining dividend - prorated published fund expense
earnings_normalization: Starting valuation-relevant earnings power is normalized to 1, not measured sector NTM EPS. Changes are explicit analyst assumptions, not extrapolated annual growth or observed NTM estimates.
dividend_policy: Future dividends unconfirmed; run-rate proxy or explicit conservative assumption. Past ex-dividend distributions paid after entry are excluded. Sensitivity also uses zero remaining dividend.
fees_policy: Published fund expense ratio * 83/365; this is an illustrative forward expense estimate. Historical NAV returns already include fund fees and are not adjusted again.
